name: Rare Michigan | Macinawe
description: Macinawe: Prepare for a powerful experience with this indica-dominant cannabis flower. Featuring hard, dense buds coated in a thick layer of huge trichomes, this strain delivers a potent and physically relaxing effect. Expect a classic gas aroma with notes of pine and earth, making it a favorite among connoisseurs.
